output.situation: The AI-caused telecom network incident has affected emergency call connections in Downtown, and the root cause is an ML energy-saving model v2.3 that puts cells to sleep during peak crowds.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-CD-COORDINATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Coordinate the services needed to address potential risks (civil defence). Permitted action types: activate_crisis_coordination, share_information.
applicable_rules.why: To coordinate and address the risk of emergency call failures due to the AI-caused telecom network incident.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-PUBLIC-ALERT — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Operate the public alert system.
applicable_rules.why: To inform the public about potential risks and ensure they are aware of the situation.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-INFORMATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Obtain information from the competent and concerned authorities.
applicable_rules.why: To gather more information about the root cause of the incident.

applicable_rules.quote: Channel CH-A3-A4-COORD: A3 → A4 (CDA → competent/concerned authorities (coordination)).
applicable_rules.why: To coordinate with other relevant authorities for a comprehensive response to the incident.

output.why: Given the situation, sharing information about the root cause with the Health & Ambulance Authority is crucial as it will help in coordinating emergency services and ensuring that they are prepared for potential delays or failures.

messages.content: Share information: Root cause of AI-caused telecom network incident - ML energy-saving model v2.3 puts cells to sleep at crowd peak.

questions_to_adviser: Should we also consider activating the public alert system to inform the public about this issue?
